price_models.growth54: Original production monthly real-growth model, Apr2022-Sep2026 N54
price_models.growth57: Same form re-estimated Jan2022-Sep2026 N57, near-zero positive market coefficient
price_models.level57: Real-index level with cumulative events, Jan2022-Sep2026 N57

fixed_inputs: Mortgage nominal values, cash area, CPI, launch ratio, class allocation, completion profiles and delays, price anchor, terminal Q2031=Q2030.
solver: All future monthly prices solved jointly with endogenous mortgage areas, launches and cohort inventories. Alternate initialization/damping checked at alpha=1 for every price model.
level_seed: Level model uses the original growth path only as a numerical starting guess; its evaluation and final fixed point use level coefficients exclusively.
period_warning: Different price samples are sensitivity, not a parameter selection by desired output; p-values and historical forecast limitations remain unchanged.
future_launches: 2026 launches fixed; alpha changes only 2027 onward.
status: Research sensitivity; no final price model or launch speed selected
